what: Inline icons in R Markdown and Quarto
title: Getting started
text: iconify_html() returns raw HTML, works inline code. example, `r iconifyr::iconify_html("mdi:github", size = 16)` renders . chunk, use results = "asis": function works Shiny UI code, e.g. tags$button(iconify_html("mdi:refresh"), "Reload").
code: ```{r, results = "asis"} iconifyr::iconify_html("mdi:home", color = "steelblue", size = 32) ```

title: Getting started
code: ids <- c("mdi:home", "mdi:account", "mdi:cog") tbl <- data.frame(   id = ids,   icon = vapply(ids, function(x) as.character(iconify_get(x, size = 20)), ""),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) gt::gt(tbl) |>   gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "icon")

title: Getting started
text: iconify_png() renders rsvg. place icon plot, rasterize SVG add annotation.
code: svg <- iconify_get("mdi:star", color = "#e0a800", size = 128) img <- rsvg::rsvg_nativeraster(charToRaw(svg), width = 128) grob <- grid::rasterGrob(img, interpolate = TRUE)  ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(2, 3, 5)), ggplot2::aes(x, y)) +   ggplot2::geom_line() +   ggplot2::annotation_custom(grob, xmin = 1, xmax = 1.5, ymin = 4, ymax = 5) +   ggplot2::theme_minimal()

title: Getting started
code: paths <- iconify_download(c("mdi:home", "tabler:star"), dir = tempdir()) basename(paths) #> [1] "mdi-home.svg"    "tabler-star.svg"

title: Getting started
text: Responses cached tools::R_user_dir("iconifyr", "cache"). Turn options(iconifyr.cache = FALSE); wipe iconify_cache_clear(). Requests retry 3 times HTTP 429 5xx. Point package self-hosted API options(iconifyr.api = "https://icons.example.org").

title: Icon gallery
text: Using icon means following set’s license. iconify_license() returns need credit line:
code: sets_used <- c(   "mdi", "tabler", "lucide", "ph", "bi", "carbon", "fa6-solid",   "fa6-brands", "simple-icons", "logos", "twemoji", "flat-color-icons" ) lic <- lapply(sets_used, iconify_license, quiet = TRUE) data.frame(   prefix = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "prefix"),   license = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "license"),   author = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "author"),   attribution = ifelse(vapply(lic, function(x) isTRUE(x$attribution_required), NA), "required", "-") ) #>              prefix    license                     author attribution #> 1               mdi Apache 2.0              Pictogrammers           - #> 2            tabler        MIT                 Paweł Kuna           - #> 3            lucide        ISC        Lucide Contributors           - #> 4                ph        MIT             Phosphor Icons           - #> 5                bi        MIT      The Bootstrap Authors           - #> 6            carbon Apache 2.0                        IBM           - #> 7         fa6-solid  CC BY 4.0                 Dave Gandy    required #> 8        fa6-brands  CC BY 4.0                 Dave Gandy    required #> 9      simple-icons    CC0 1.0 Simple Icons Collaborators           - #> 10            logos        CC0                Gil Barbara           - #> 11          twemoji  CC BY 4.0                    Twitter    required #> 12 flat-color-icons        MIT                     Icons8           -

title: Licensing
text: iconify_license() accepts set prefix full icon id. license requires attribution (Creative Commons Attribution licenses CC 4.0, ODbL), also prints message. Silence quiet = TRUE. result list, can build credit line :
code: lic <- iconify_license("fa6-solid") #> ! "Font Awesome 6 Solid" ("fa6-solid") is licensed "CC BY 4.0": attribution is required. Credit "Dave Gandy". lic #> Font Awesome 6 Solid (fa6-solid) #>   License:              CC BY 4.0 (CC-BY-4.0) #>   License URL:          https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ #>   Author:               Dave Gandy #>   Author URL:           https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome #>   Attribution required: yes sprintf("Icons: %s by %s (%s), %s", lic$set, lic$author, lic$url, lic$license) #> [1] "Icons: Font Awesome 6 Solid by Dave Gandy (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), CC BY 4.0"

title: Get an icon as SVG — iconify_get
text: id Icon id form "prefix:name", e.g. "mdi:home". color Icon color: CSS color name hex string "#ba3329". affects monotone icons. size Icon height pixels, "auto", "unset" "none". width follows icon's aspect ratio. NULL keeps API default (1em). flip One "horizontal", "vertical", "". rotate 90, 180 270 degrees ("90deg" also works). combined flip, icon flipped first.
